title: Cafe Manager
description:
**Company Description**

The cafe is a customer-focused food and beverage destination located in Ghaziabad, offering a welcoming environment for guests to relax, socialize, and enjoy quality refreshments. It emphasizes consistent service standards, clean and comfortable surroundings, and a menu designed to appeal to a broad range of tastes. The team works collaboratively to ensure smooth daily operations and a positive guest experience. The cafe values reliability, professionalism, and a strong commitment to hospitality. It aims to be a preferred neighborhood spot through attentive service and well-managed operations.

**Role Description**

The Cafe Manager is responsible for overseeing daily cafe operations, ensuring excellent customer service, and maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment. This full-time, on-site role in Ghaziabad includes managing staff schedules, supervising team performance, and supporting training for service and hygiene standards. The Cafe Manager monitors inventory, oversees ordering and stock rotation, and helps control costs while maintaining quality in food and beverage offerings. The role also involves handling guest inquiries and concerns, coordinating sales and promotional activities, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and regulatory requirements. The Manager collaborates with leadership to meet revenue targets, optimize workflows, and support a positive, inclusive workplace.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Customer Service skills, with a focus on guest satisfaction and problem-solving.
* Effective Communication abilities, including clear verbal communication with guests and team members.
* Knowledge of Food & Beverage operations, including menu items, quality standards, and presentation.
* Experience in Food Service, such as order handling, service flow, hygiene practices, and basic kitchen coordination.
* Sales skills to support upselling, promotions, and achievement of revenue goals.
* Previous experience in cafe, restaurant, or hospitality management is preferred.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team, manage schedules, and handle peak-hour operations.
* Basic understanding of inventory management, cash handling, and point-of-sale systems.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to cleanliness and safety standards.
* Relevant diploma or degree in hospitality, business, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Pacwell™ SRV LLP is a specialized manufacturer of sterilization pouches and reels based in Greater Noida, India. With over 30 years of experience in flexible packaging, the company focuses on delivering consistent, reliable, and audit-ready sterile packaging solutions. Pacwell™ SRV LLP serves hospitals, medical device manufacturers, and healthcare distributors who require high-quality, compliant packaging. Team members work in an environment that values precision, quality assurance, and long-term customer partnerships. The company offers opportunities to contribute to products that support patient safety and healthcare standards.

**Role Description**
The Production Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Greater Noida, responsible for overseeing daily production operations on the shop floor. This role includes planning and monitoring production schedules, allocating resources, and ensuring that output meets quality, safety, and compliance standards for sterile packaging products. The Production Supervisor coordinates with cross-functional teams, communicates production priorities, and addresses any operational issues or bottlenecks. Day-to-day tasks involve supervising production staff, tracking performance metrics, maintaining documentation, and driving continuous improvement in processes. The role also requires adherence to regulatory requirements, participation in audits, and support of training initiatives for production personnel.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to demonstrate strong Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, performance monitoring, and coaching.
* Experience managing Production Schedules and coordinating workflow to meet delivery timelines and quality targets.
* Proficiency in Production Planning and resource allocation to optimize efficiency and reduce downtime.
* Effective Communication skills for collaborating with production teams, quality assurance, maintenance, and management.
* Hands-on experience in Production Management, including process oversight, documentation, and compliance with safety standards.
* Background in manufacturing, preferably in packaging, medical devices, or healthcare-related products.
* Knowledge of quality systems, basic lean manufacturing or continuous improvement practices is an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in engineering, manufacturing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida and manage shift-based operations as required.

title: Technical Delivery Lead
description:

Your expertise will be instrumental in driving services and CARE delivery management, establishing long-term relationships with customers, and managing demand updates and effort approvals. As a key bridge between region needs and domain service execution, you will be responsible for CN TDU deliverables, revenue-impacting risk management, and ensuring 100% LNI compliances.

* Lead and own customer deliverables with high accuracy and quality, collaborating with domain services and technical support units.
* Drive services and CARE delivery management, establishing sustainable customer relationships.
* Own region interactions, customer delivery expectations, and technical alignment, manage demand updates, effort approvals, and partner work-package order approvals.
* Lead service and technical escalation management across delivery and support teams.
* Accountable for quality forecasting, on-time delivery, and cost control for CN TDU deliverables.
* Act as the liaison between region needs and domain service execution, ensuring alignment.
* Improve customer satisfaction by fulfilling contractual commitments and minimizing quality issues.
* Accountable for CN TDU deliverables during the project execution phase, initiating improvement actions, s upport project teams in discussions with PLM for cases involving pre-c3 features.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must have:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field with 15+ years of experience in project management or a technical lead role, preferably in the telecom industry.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on customer satisfaction and quality.
* Proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with experience in resource allocation and demand forecasting.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously, familiarity with telecom network technologies and services is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail, willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.

**Nice to have:**

* Knowledge of telecom services and operations, experience working in global or multicultural teams.
* Exposure to digital transformation or network modernization projects, continuous learning mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies.

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .

description:

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Operations Manager to serve as the senior management presence during the IST shift, overseeing the effective functioning of approximately 20 employees across multiple teams.

Team Leads will continue to manage their respective functions. This Manager will work across teams to ensure that work gets done on time, company standards and SOPs are followed, quality is maintained, and Team Leads and employees remain accountable.

* Monitor operational KPIs, productivity, outstanding tasks and quality indicators.
* Ensure company policies, processes and management instructions are consistently followed.
* Coordinate cross-functional issues and prevent work from falling between departments.
* Recommend improvements to processes, SOPs, controls and operational workflows.
* Escalate significant performance, conduct, quality or compliance concerns to Executive Management.
* Provide a concise
  **daily management report**

  covering exceptions, missed deliverables, audit findings, corrective actions, recurring issues and matters requiring executive attention.

Ideal Candidate:

* **7–12+ years of professional experience**

  , with significant operations/management responsibility.
* Proven experience managing Team Leads, supervisors or multi-functional teams.
* Experience overseeing approximately
  **15–50+ employees**

  preferred.
* Strong background in operations, quality assurance, process management, audits or compliance.
* Highly organized, analytical and comfortable holding people accountable.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
* Confident working directly with founders and senior management.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in healthcare, education, technology, BPO/KPO or another process-driven/regulated environment is advantageous.

What success looks like:

Success means stronger operational discipline, fewer recurring errors, higher SOP compliance, timely completion of deliverables, faster resolution of issues, stronger Team Lead accountability and consistently high-quality work across the organization.

We are looking for someone who is visible, proactive and execution-focused—someone who does not wait for problems to reach them, but actively understands what is happening across teams, identifies gaps early and ensures that commitments are followed through to completion.

title: Lead - Program Management
description:
About the role

Adani Realty is hiring a Lead – Program Management to run the PMO for large infrastructure and urban redevelopment programmes from Noida. Project monitoring & execution

• Monitor contractor and consultant performance on scope, quality and timelines.

• Identify bottlenecks, drive corrective actions with the teams, run periodic project reviews and escalate critical issues to management.

Financial & budgeting

• Co-own the programme financial model with the Finance & Strategy team and keep refining it to maximise benefits.

• Run a monthly Earned Value Analysis against the baseline plan, reporting cost and schedule variances, root causes and CAPA.

• Measure project ROI every month and run sensitivity analysis to flag drag-down factors and course corrections.

• Assess the impact of key decisions on contracts, cost, schedule and manpower, and recommend adjustments.

Quality & compliance

• Maintain quality controls that keep defects within defined limits.

• Keep execution aligned with ESG, Smart City and Net Zero commitments.

Stakeholder coordination

• Resolve issues with internal teams, contractors and consultants; hold regular reviews with department heads.

• Liaise with regulatory bodies to stay within statutory guidelines.

Risk management & reporting

• Identify risks and own mitigation plans.

• Report exceptions, safety concerns and non-compliance, along with project status, cost variances and corrective actions.

You will work with

Internal: CEO and senior leadership, Finance, Project Execution, Engineering & Design, Techno-Commercial, Legal & Compliance, Facilities Management, Safety, IT, and HR & Administration.

External: regulatory authorities, government bodies and municipal corporations, contractors and vendors, consultants and advisory firms, investors and financial institutions, technology partners, and the local community and residents.

What we are looking for

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred.

• 12–14 years of experience in project execution, infrastructure or urban redevelopment.

• Strong grounding in project governance, financial tracking (EVA, ROI, sensitivity analysis), risk mitigation and impact analysis.

title: Supply Chain Manager - Import
description:
**Supply Chain Manager – Import**

**About the company**

Raphe mPhibr Pvt. Ltd is India’s largest R&D-driven UAV manufacturer, revolutionizing aerospace with indigenously developed, cutting-edge drone technology. Our UAVs have flown over 1 million kilometres across diverse terrains and weather conditions.

With 900+ talented professionals trained at premier institutions like MIT, Georgia Tech, IITs, and NITs and state-of-the-art research and manufacturing facilities, we design and build almost every component of our UAVs in-house. Our expertise spans Aerodynamics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Software, and AI, enabling us to create comprehensive and customized end-to-end solutions.

Recognized for our rapid growth and inclusive culture, we were recently named LinkedIn's Top 10 Startups 2024 and honoured with the FICCI Women's Empowerment Award. Beyond work, we foster a collaborative, fun, and inclusive workplace, supported by unique events and thoughtful policies that reflect our commitment to our people We innovate for a better society!

We innovate for a better society!

**Do you want?**

* The opportunity to work alongside highly innovative and technical minds?
* A competitive salary based on your skills?
* To make sure every critical import clears customs and reaches us on the promised date, at a landed cost we can defend?

**Job Brief:**

We are looking for a
**Supply Chain Manager - Import**
to own how every imported component & material reaches Raphe, from supplier dispatch to customs clearance and goods receipt. You will maintain CHA relationships and run compliant import operations, including controlled-goods paperwork, keep landed cost under control, and recover fast when a shipment slips. You will lead a team of logistics and imports specialists and use data to show what is working.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic, fast-growing team? If yes, then let’s solve the real problems and innovate newer possibilities. Sounds interesting? Come, join us on this incredible journey!

Don’t just dream about what’s next – build it!

**Essential Skills:**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian customs procedures, documentation and duty handling.
* Experience managing shipping documents (invoice, packing list, AWB/BL) and customs clearance with brokers.
* Hands-on experience with import licensing and controlled-goods paperwork (DGFT, SCOMET, end-user certificates).
* Strong working relationships with Custom Housing Agents (CHAs) and freight forwarders, and the ability to brief and manage them.
* Working knowledge of export-control classification for controlled electronics (EAR / dual-use).
* Strong understanding of Incoterms: where cost, risk and delivery transfer, and how that affects landed cost.
* Experience choosing air, sea or courier, and briefing and managing international freight forwarders.
* Experience in delivery management: track every open import against the promised date and drive recovery on critical lines.
* Understanding of payment terms, liability, warranty and penalty clauses well enough to spot risk.
* Team leadership skills, with the ability to coach and develop others.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Logistics cost management: consolidating shipments, controlling premium freight and balancing speed against cost.
* Disruption planning: alternate routes and recovery actions lined up before a disruption.
* Exposure to government or defence procurement rules.
* Background in aerospace, defence, drone (UAS) or a related high-tech industry is a plus.

**As Supply Chain Manager - Import, you will:**

* Own import operations at Raphe, from supplier dispatch to customs clearance and goods receipt.
* Ensure every import is compliant, with documents, licences, end-user certificates and classifications in place before shipment.
* Manage customs brokers and international freight forwarders, and hold them to agreed timelines and costs.
* Choose the freight mode and Incoterms for each shipment that protect the date at the lowest landed cost.
* Track every open import against its promised date, spot delays early and drive recovery on critical lines.
* Run a disciplined overdue-shipment list and escalate with dates.
* Coordinate goods receipt with stores and quality so imported material is booked in and released quickly.
* Control duty, freight and premium-freight costs, and consolidate shipments.
* Line up alternate routes and recovery actions for critical imports before a disruption.
* Share meaningful insights with leadership, such as landed cost, clearance times, on-time delivery and premium-freight spend.
* Lead and develop a team of logistics and imports specialists.
* Document what is learned about parts, suppliers and systems so the next person starts faster.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
* Certification in international trade, EXIM or customs procedures (e.g. IIFT, FIEO, Customs Broker license) is a plus.
* 6–10 years of experience in import operations, EXIM or international logistics, with at least 2 years leading a team.

* Own the Material Delivery Plan and make sure shortages are caught before they hinder research or production.
* Build a qualified, risk-balanced supplier base in India and abroad, with dual sources for critical items.
* Keep the total cost of what we buy under control through negotiation, and category strategy.
* Ensure incoming material meets the required quality standards and that supplier corrective actions are closed.
* Make sure imports and controlled items are compliant, and that freight decisions protect dates at the lowest landed cost.
* Define and track supply chain KPIs such as on-time delivery, lead time, savings, stock levels, shortages and supplier defect rates.
* Share meaningful insights with leadership, and escalate risks early with recovery options.
* Build a culture where every learning about parts, suppliers and systems is written down for the next person.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration ora related field.
* MBA in Operations / Supply Chain, or a certification such as CPSM, CSCP or CIPS, is a plus.
* 10–15 years of experience in supply chain, with at least 4 years leading teams that include managers or senior specialists.

title: Hospitality Manager
description:
**About the job**

Join Sodexo India and be part of a dynamic team committed to delivering exceptional food services, operational excellence and quality-of-life services.

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused
**Hospitality Manager**
to lead food service operations at our client site. The role will be responsible for ensuring high standards of food quality, service delivery, hygiene, safety and operational efficiency while driving business growth and site profitability.

As the key operational leader at the site, you will oversee end-to-end food operations, menu planning, inventory and cost management, team performance, client relationships and compliance requirements. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders, including Operations, HR, QMHSE and H&FS teams, to ensure consistent service delivery and customer satisfaction.

We seek an individual with strong hospitality expertise, business acumen, financial understanding and people management capabilities, along with a passion for food quality, service excellence and continuous improvement.

**Main objectives and expectations:**

**Food Operations & Service Excellence**

* Ensure all food service deliveries are carried out in accordance with the terms and conditions agreed upon with the client.
* Manage menu and recipe rotation for breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner and special events.
* Initiate the development of new menus, upgrade existing menus and create special event menus.
* Conduct food tasting before service and develop innovative ideas for promotions, festivals and special events.
* Plan and supervise pre-preparation activities to ensure food items are processed according to approved recipes.
* Consistently maintain food quality, cost, presentation and taste standards.

**Quality, Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict implementation of food safety, hygiene and workplace safety policies at the site.
* Monitor the quality and quantity of raw materials and ensure ingredients are received as per defined specifications.
* Train receiving-area staff on ingredient quality and inspection standards.
* Maintain records of hygiene procedures, initiatives and incidents.
* Coordinate with QMHSE and H&FS teams for implementation of policies and processes.
* Ensure timely reporting of all QMHSE and H&FS-related incidents to the concerned teams.
* Maintain operational ownership of QMHSE and H&FS processes and communicate potential site hazards to the concerned departments.

**Business Growth & Profitability**

* Drive organic sales growth and business development through service excellence, retail offers and value-added services.
* Monitor site profitability through regular analysis of operational and financial reports.
* Identify business and operational discrepancies and implement corrective measures to improve profitability.
* Ensure effective cost control and efficient utilization of resources.

**Cash, Debtors & Financial Management**

* Ensure accurate cash handling, control, handover and deposit procedures.
* Maintain all prescribed cash control documents and records.
* Ensure invoices are raised and delivered to clients within agreed schedules.
* Monitor financial processes and support timely resolution of billing-related issues.

**People Management & Training**

* Lead and manage the on-site operational team, including cooks, MPWs, stewards, cashiers and store assistants.
* Ensure effective manpower deployment and coordination across food service operations.
* Implement applicable HR processes and employee welfare activities.
* Drive team engagement, training and capability development to maintain operational standards.

**Client Relationship Management & Retention**

* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding service delivery, operational issues, additional business opportunities and new initiatives.
* Proactively address client concerns and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of client discussions, initiatives and agreed actions.
* Drive customer satisfaction and ensure 100% client retention.

**Wastage Control & Cost Management**

* Maintain daily records of food leftovers and use consumption trends to plan production requirements.
* Minimize food wastage through effective production planning and portion control.
* Ensure surplus ingredients are utilized appropriately in other dishes, strictly adhering to food safety and hygiene standards.

**Procurement & Inventory Management**

* Monitor daily raw material indent requirements.
* Ensure effective coordination of procurement and inventory activities.
* Monitor raw material availability, quality and consumption to support uninterrupted food operations and cost control.

**Systems, Processes & Legal Compliance**

* Ensure implementation of company systems, policies and operational procedures.
* Ensure all work processes are properly documented and displayed at the site.
* Coordinate with HR, QMHSE and Legal departments to ensure applicable statutory and legal compliances are fulfilled.
* Maintain copies of relevant compliance documents and records.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Graduate / Diploma in Hotel Management or Hospitality Management; preferably an IHM graduate.
* Minimum
  **4+ years of relevant work experience**
  in hospitality, food services, institutional catering or related operations.
* Strong understanding of large-scale food service operations, menu planning and food production management.
* Sound knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards, QMHSE processes and operational compliance.
* Strong business acumen with an understanding of site profitability, budgeting and financial management.
* Experience in cash handling, debtor management, invoicing and cost control.
* Good understanding of raw material procurement, inventory management and food wastage control.
* Proven people management skills with the ability to lead and develop diverse operational teams.
* Strong client relationship management and customer retention capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-focused approach.
* Well-groomed, professional and capable of representing Sodexo in client-facing environments.

**What We Look For:**

We seek a proactive hospitality professional who can independently manage site operations, lead teams, maintain food quality and hygiene standards, build strong client relationships and contribute to business growth and profitability.

If you are passionate about hospitality operations and delivering exceptional food service experiences, we invite you to join Sodexo India.

**Position:**
Hospitality Manager

**Reporting To:**
Site Director / Site Manager / Operations Manager

**Experience:**
4+ Years

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Hindustan Parking Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd (HPIPL) is an Indian brand focused on designing, manufacturing, and installing next-generation parking systems that enhance urban mobility and efficiency. Guided by a Make in India approach, the company combines Indian engineering with global technology standards, using ISO-certified materials and strict quality assurance for durability and safety. HPIPL specializes in innovative, automated, and sustainable parking solutions for buses, trucks, cars, bikes, and fully automatic systems, serving housing complexes, offices, airports, and commercial spaces. The company’s mission is to create smart spaces that transform cities, empower industries, and simplify everyday life.

The Production Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida, responsible for overseeing daily production operations and ensuring that manufacturing targets are met safely and efficiently. This role includes planning and monitoring production schedules, allocating workforce and resources, and coordinating with procurement, quality, and installation teams to meet project timelines. The Production Supervisor will track production output, troubleshoot issues on the shop floor, and implement process improvements to optimize productivity, reduce waste, and maintain product quality. The role also involves maintaining compliance with safety standards, keeping accurate production records, and providing clear communication and guidance to production staff. The supervisor will collaborate closely with management to report performance metrics and support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with HPIPL’s technology and quality standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, performance monitoring, and workforce coordination on the shop floor.

* Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Production Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, or infrastructure projects, ideally within capital equipment or engineering sectors, is beneficial.
* Working knowledge of production reporting tools, basic MS Office, and familiarity with ISO and safety compliance practices is an advantage.
* Ability to work in fast-paced environments, solve operational issues, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Director- Revenue Operations & Intelligence
description: About the company Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement. At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized. Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact. Follow the video below to know about us! Clipchamp Role Overview We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance. The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization. This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical specialists to implement scalable improvements. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Revenue Intelligence Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth. Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms. Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards. 2. Commercial Performance & Predictability Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk. Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams. Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability. 3. Revenue Operating Model Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures. Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle. Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model. 4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness. Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights. Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization. Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights. 5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth. Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption. Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements. Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements. 6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness. Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes. Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists. Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes. Required Technical Skills & Competencies Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field. 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy. At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management. Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth. Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required. Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools. Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI. Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority. Must-Have Skills Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy. Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management. Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization. Strong commercial and financial acumen. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce for Revenue Operations, including governance, data quality, workflows, adoption, and integrations. Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools such as Power BI. Experience developing executive-level reporting, defining business metrics, and translating analysis into actionable recommendations. Ability to align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Alliances, and other stakeholders around shared commercial outcomes. Strong process design, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities. Good to Have Skills Experience in technology services, SaaS, consulting, cloud, AI, digital engineering, or another complex B2B environment. Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Amplemarket. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or equivalent platforms to improve analysis, workflows, data quality, or decision support. Exposure to SQL, data modeling, advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled decision support. Ability to learn adjacent GTM platforms and technologies quickly. Desired Attributes A strategic thinker who remains grounded in data and measurable business outcomes. Intellectually curious, independent in judgment, and commercially pragmatic. Comfortable working directly with senior executives and functional leaders. Strong at distinguishing between commercial, process, data, and technology issues. Highly structured, proactive, and disciplined in prioritization and follow-through. A collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a great personality.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:
Pegasus, part of the B. Jain Group, is an established children’s publishing brand with a wide portfolio of books, educational products and screen-free learning experiences.

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

description:
**Req ID:**
393558
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Infra & Cloud Service Delivery Director to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).

At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations & Delivery Control
  
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change & Risk Management
  
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor & Asset Management
  
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency & Financial Operations
  
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations & Governance
  
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps & Continual Improvement
  
  

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

People Leadership
  
  

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.
* Strong experience in major incident, problem, change, risk, transition, service improvement and operational governance.
* Working financial knowledge covering cost control, forecasting inputs, productivity, utilization and margin drivers.
* Broad understanding of cloud, compute, storage, backup, virtualization, operating systems, networks, cybersecurity and ITSM operations.
* ITIL v4 certification is required; relevant cloud, infrastructure, security or service-management certifications are preferred.
* Strong client communication, structured problem solving, data-driven decision making and ability to influence cross-functional global teams.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: Director, Accounts Payable
description:
At Aristocrat, we are passionate about offering outstanding gaming experiences to millions of players globally. As a worldwide leader in gaming content and technology, our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play. We maintain strong governance and operational excellence with a focus on responsible business practices. This role presents an outstanding chance to lead our global Accounts Payable function. You will play a key role in crafting the future of our Source-to-Pay operating model and influencing our organization significantly. Join us in our goal to transform industry standards and promote operational excellence!
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own and direct the global Accounts Payable function across business units, regions, and shared service operations, holding enterprise-wide responsibility for AP strategy, governance, service delivery, controls, and performance.
* Define and complete the global Accounts Payable strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Finance and Source-to-Pay priorities.
* Establish the global AP operating model, governance framework, service standards, important metrics, and performance expectations across regions and business units.
* Offer strategic leadership and supervision to regional AP managers and operational teams, ensuring clear accountability and reliable delivery throughout the global function.
* Advance consistency, scalability, and operational excellence across global AP processes while building frameworks that encourage organizational development.
* Serve as the senior AP leader responsible for advising Finance leadership on AP strategy, transformation priorities, organizational build, risk, controls, and investment decisions.
* Maintain enterprise accountability for timely and accurate invoice processing and payment execution, including improvements in invoice cycle times, payment accuracy, and exception management.
* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, adherence, and audit preparedness throughout global AP operations.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency, service quality, and the overall employee and supplier experience.
* Provide strategic leadership throughout the entire Source-to-Pay process, collaborating with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Tax, Technology, and business leaders to set enterprise priorities, governance, and transformation initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives spanning AP, Procurement Operations, supplier management, payment operations, ERP and workflow technology, and financial controls.
* Drive alignment with Procurement Operations on PO quality, supplier onboarding, invoice matching, workflow optimization, data integrity, and operational governance.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Over 10 years of experience in Accounts Payable, shared services, finance operations, or related Source-to-Pay functions.
* Over 5 years of experience directing global or regional AP teams, with responsibility for managers or distributed teams.
* Proven experience managing or directing enterprise-wide AP strategy, governance, operating models, and performance.
* Experience operating in a global shared-service or highly matrixed environment.
* Solid knowledge of complete Source-to-Pay workflows, AP operational controls, adherence to regulations, and risk oversight.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale operational transformation, process standardization, automation, and organizational change.
* Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior collaborators across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Technology, and business functions.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and financial competence, with the ability to translate operational metrics and insights into enterprise priorities and decisions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Experience with ERP, workflow, invoice automation, analytics, and AI-enabled finance technologies.
* Experience leading operational transitions, shared-service evolution, or organizational redesign initiatives.

Step into a role where your leadership and expertise can deliver a world-class impact. Join Aristocrat and be part of our ambitious journey to redefine Source-to-Pay operations!
  
  
*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Assistant Quality Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Quality Manager to oversee process quality and Outgoing Quality Control (OQC) for lithium-ion battery pack assembly and manufacturing for mobile phones. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining product quality, improving manufacturing processes, implementing quality management systems, conducting customer and supplier audits, and ensuring compliance with established quality standards and customer requirements.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Manage process quality and OQC activities for lithium-ion battery pack assembly and manufacturing.
* Monitor manufacturing processes to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure compliance with established specifications and quality standards.
* Develop, review, and implement PFMEA, Control Plans, and other quality documentation.
* Apply quality tools such as FMEA, DOE, PPAP, and 8D to support process improvement and problem-solving.
* Conduct and coordinate customer audits and supplier audits, including Quality Process Audits (QPA).
* Investigate customer complaints, process deviations, and product non-conformities; coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain and improve the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensure compliance with applicable procedures.
* Coordinate with production, engineering, suppliers, and other relevant teams to resolve quality issues and improve manufacturing performance.
* Prepare quality reports, audit documentation, presentations, and performance updates using MS Office tools.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control within manufacturing.
* Hands-on knowledge of lithium-ion battery pack assembly/manufacturing for mobile phones is mandatory.
* Practical knowledge of process quality and Outgoing Quality Control (OQC).
* Working knowledge of PFMEA, DOE, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, 8D, and QMS.
* Experience in customer audits and supplier audits, particularly QPA.
* Good command of spoken and written English.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Package Manager - Casting
description:
The Package Manager is responsible for the overall management and delivery performance of supplier-provided goods and services within a project environment.
  
  
He/She ensures that supplier commitments are met in terms of schedule adherence, cost performance, and documentation compliance, while working closely with Project Management, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
  
  
The position reports directly to the Commodity Sourcing Team Leader.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
Supplier Delivery Management
  
  

* Assume overall responsibility for order fulfilment activities for the assigned project scope.
* Define the expediting strategy no later than the Notice to Proceed (NTP), in coordination with the Project Procurement Leader (PPLM) and the Project Quality Manager (PQM).
* Ensure alignment of the expediting strategy with the project schedule, Engineering Procurement Plan (EPP), Master Time Schedule, and allocated budget.

Coordination and Performance Management
  
  

* Coordinate and leverage expediting activities together with Supplier Quality (SQ) teams to maximize synergies across projects, suppliers, and sites.
* Lead regular reviews of critical procurement packages with the PPLM.
* Closely monitor expediting-related costs and ensure compliance with the Order Fulfilment budget.
* Provide early warnings in the event of schedule slippage or delivery risks.

Operational Follow-up and Reporting
  
  

* Confirm completion of deliverables and receipt of equipment within project tracking systems (PMX) to ensure accurate On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance reporting.
* Contribute to budgeting and forecasting activities related to Order Fulfilment.
* Prepare and issue periodic consolidated reports (e.g., through digital tools such as SUMO), including delivery status, risks, and opportunities.
* Ensure compliance with Group processes, tools, standards, and methodologies related to Order Fulfilment activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
**The Supplier Performance Manager Is Assessed, Among Others, On**

* Complete and on-time delivery of project equipment and procurement packages.
* Compliance with allocated budgets.
* Effectiveness of mitigation and recovery plans.
* Quality, accuracy, and timeliness of reporting.
* Adherence to global processes and quality of data maintained in company systems.

Autonomy and Authority
  
  

* Ability to make decisions and provide direction within the assigned area of responsibility, in alignment with project stakeholders.

**Required Competencies**

* Basic knowledge of Quality Management, commercial considerations, planning, scheduling, and industrial operations.
* Experience in supplier management and delivery performance monitoring.
* Proficiency with business systems, databases, and digital tools.

**Profile And Qualifications**
Education and Experience
  
  

* Minimum Bachelor's degree (Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or equivalent).
* Significant experience in Procurement and/or Project Management, ideally supporting complex, high-value projects.
* Strong contract management knowledge and experience.

Key Skills
  
  

* Leadership and strong team-oriented mindset.
* Proactive approach with strong anticipation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and resource management skills.
* Ability to prepare professional reports, procedures, and business communications.
* Strong communication skills with internal stakeholders, customers, and third parties.

Languages
  
  

* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

**Additional Requirements**

* Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in one or more of the following industries: Power Generation, Heavy Industry, Nuclear, Aerospace.
* Basic knowledge of project management principles.
* Awareness of financial, legal, and risk management considerations.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and adapt quickly within a project-driven environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS
  
  

* Availability for frequent business travel.
* Position operating within a demanding industrial environment.
* Frequent interactions with international internal and external stakeholders.

title: Construction - India
description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Engineer / Lead / Manager reporting directly to our Site / Line Manager / Construction to join our team based in India.
  
  
**About us:**
Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality.
  
  
Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last.
  
  
**About The Opportunity We Offer**
*Starting Date: Sep / Oct/Nov / Dec*
**About you:**
We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements:
  
  
**Construction Manager:**

* Oversee site construction activities and contractor performance.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and project requirements.
* Monitor project schedules, budgets, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, and Commissioning teams.
* Manage construction risks, progress reporting, and issue resolution.
* Support commissioning, startup, and project handover.

**Electrical:**

* Manage installation of HV/MV/LV systems, substations, switchgear, transformers, and cabling.
* Supervise contractors and site teams to meet project schedules and quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, project specifications, and industry standards.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA/QC, Procurement, and Commissioning teams.
* Support testing, energization, commissioning, and handover activities.

**Instrumentation**

* Manage installation of instrumentation, control systems, DCS, PLC, ESD, and Fire & Gas systems.
* Coordinate construction activities with Engineering, QA/QC, HSE, and Commissioning teams.
* Supervise contractors and ensure adherence to project specifications and schedules.
* Oversee cable installation, instrument calibration, loop checks, and system testing.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and industry standards.
* Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and project handover activities.

**RCM:**

* Manage multiple construction projects and site teams across the region.
* Ensure compliance with project schedules, budgets, quality, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee EPC contractors and subcontractor performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Commissioning, and Operations teams.
* Monitor project progress, risks, and resource allocation.
* Drive construction best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support project commissioning, handover, and close-out activities.

**Piping:**

* Lead piping construction activities for refinery and oil & gas projects.
* Supervise piping installation, fabrication, erection, testing, and hydrotesting.
* Manage contractors, subcontractors, and site teams.
* Ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, codes, and quality requirements.
* Monitor construction schedules, manpower, productivity, and costs.
* Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and mechanical completion activities.
* Enforce HSE policies and ensure a safe work environment.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA/QC, Planning, and Operations teams.

**Structural Lead:**
Lead structural construction activities for Oil & Gas, refinery, and petrochemical projects, ensuring safe, quality, and timely execution of structural steel, equipment foundations, and civil-structural works.
  
  

* Supervise structural steel fabrication and erection activities.
* Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Coordinate with Civil, Mechanical, Piping, and Construction teams.
* Monitor contractor performance, construction progress, and quality standards.
* Support site inspections, risk assessments, and project handover activities.

**Civil Lead**
:
  
  
Lead and supervise civil construction activities for Oil & Gas, refinery, petrochemical, and industrial projects, ensuring safe, quality, and timely execution of civil works.
  
  

* Manage civil works including foundations, buildings, roads, drainage, and underground utilities.
* Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Coordinate with Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, and Construction teams.
* Monitor contractor performance, construction progress, and quality standards.
* Support inspections, site planning, and project handover activities.

**Material Manager:**
Manage material planning, procurement coordination, inventory control, storage, and distribution for Oil & Gas construction projects to ensure timely availability of materials and efficient project execution.
  
  

* Oversee material receipt, storage, inventory, and issuance at project sites.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Construction, and Logistics teams.
* Monitor material availability to support project schedules.
* Manage warehouse operations and material tracking systems.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and HSE requirements.

**Planning**
The Planning Engineer is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for Oil & Gas construction projects. The role involves coordinating with engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure project milestones are achieved on time and within budget.
  
  

* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules using Primavera P6/MS Project.
* Monitor project progress and identify schedule risks, delays, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to track deliverables.
* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, dashboards, and look-ahead plans.
* Perform schedule analysis, critical path reviews, and resource planning.
* Support project controls, cost tracking, and change management activities.
* Ensure compliance with project timelines and contractual requirements.

**Your career with us:**
Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development
  
  
**What’s next?**
Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.
  
  
We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

Genpact’s AI Gigafactory enables clients to develop, deploy, and scale innovative AI systems, leveraging advanced technology and deep industry expertise.

**Role Purpose**

This role supports the payroll function for the client's Australia and New Zealand workforce, delivering accurate, timely, compliant pay across every cycle. You process the day-to-day payroll, keep transactions in line with AU and NZ legislation, and resolve team-member queries within SLA. You also help identify improvements, contribute to system changes and UAT, and protect data integrity across the payroll systems. It exists because dependable, compliant pay at high volume needs analysts who get the detail right on every run and keep the team-member experience smooth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Operations & Oversight**

* Oversee end-to-end preparation, processing, distribution, reconciliation, and reporting of payroll for all client employees across weekly, fortnightly, and monthly cycles in Australia and New Zealand.
* Ensure accuracy and timeliness of wage calculations, payments, and deductions; validate payroll inputs – timesheets, benefits, deductions, and bonuses – and monitor adherence to company policy.
* Manage end-to-end termination processing – final pay, Employment Termination Payments (ETPs), redundancy, leave encashments, and statutory reporting – and administer leave entitlements accurately (annual, personal, long service, parental, termination-related).
* Address and resolve complex payroll issues and escalations, drawing on deep knowledge of AU and NZ regional nuances, regulatory tasks, and country-wise deliverables.

**Compliance, Governance & Audit**

* Ensure end-to-end compliance with Australian payroll legislation – Fair Work Act, National Employment Standards, Modern Awards, Enterprise Agreements, and applicable federal and state regulations – alongside New Zealand requirements.
* Interpret and apply Modern Awards and Enterprise Agreements accurately: classifications, overtime, penalty rates, allowances, shift loadings, public-holiday payments, and leave entitlements.
* Manage PAYG withholding, Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and annual finalization, Superannuation Guarantee and Super Stream compliance, and payroll tax across states and territories – registrations, reconciliations, lodgments, and statutory reporting.
* Monitor and implement legislative and regulatory change (Fair Work, ATO, Superannuation, Wage Theft, Payroll Tax, state obligations) and validate employee and contractor classifications to mitigate misclassification risk.
* Maintain payroll governance, internal controls, and audit processes; keep records, employee data, and pay slips to legislative standards and audit-ready; and coordinate with client auditors and regulatory bodies during audits.

**Leadership & Team Oversight**

* Lead and mentor a multi-tier payroll organization – managers, payroll analysts, and specialists – building a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Set SLAs, KPIs, and quality benchmarks, allocate resources to meet deadlines and service levels, and coach the team on performance.
* Manage cyclical performance reporting, internal and external, with continuous-improvement plans, and give new team members a strong onboarding experience.
* Liaise with Quality Coaches on quality-assurance monitoring for consistent feedback and support the team on their goals and capability.

**Systems, Process & Data Integrity**

* Manage payroll systems and software, ensuring data integrity and security across all systems and processes.
* Drive automation, streamlining, and process enhancement to improve efficiency, and collaborate with client IT and HRIS teams on system upgrades and integrations.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with HR on compensation, benefits, and employee-relations matters, and communicate pay policies and procedures clearly.
* Work with Finance to reconcile payroll accounts and support budgeting and forecasting and provide payroll insights and reports to senior leadership.
* Collaborate with other Service Leads on day-to-day requirements and future improvements or projects.

**Strategic Initiatives**

* Develop payroll policies and procedures aligned with organizational goals, and lead projects across payroll transformation, mergers and acquisitions, or expansion.
* Keep employees satisfied through transparent, responsive payroll operations.

**Qualifications – Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, HR, or a related field; a master's is preferred.
* 8–12 years of Australia and New Zealand payroll experience, including at least 4–5 years in a leadership role, ideally leading complex, high-volume payroll.
* Strong working knowledge of Australian payroll legislation – Fair Work, Modern Awards, NES, PAYG, STP, Superannuation, Payroll Tax – and New Zealand legislation and the relevant Enterprise Agreements.
* Demonstrated experience managing payroll compliance in a complex, multi-state Australian environment, with a proven ability to interpret legislation and implement the resulting process changes.
* Experience with HRIS and payroll systems (ideally SuccessFactors, UKG Pro, and SAP-EC), and knowledge of Excel macros and Google Sheets for calculations.
* Strong analytical, audit, risk management, and stakeholder-management skills, with a focus on compliance, governance, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with strong leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading change as a people leader.
* Experience running payroll transformation, M&A integration, or expansion projects.

**Key Skills & Attributes**

* Confidentiality and a strong risk lens for data privacy and compliance.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in payroll calculations and compliance.
* Leadership that inspires and guides payroll teams to excellence, especially through change.
* Strategic thinking that aligns payroll with business objectives, with strong problem-solving.
* Adaptability to regulatory change and growth, with strong stakeholder collaboration and influence.

**Strategic Initiatives**

* 5–8 years of Australia and New Zealand payroll experience, including leading complex, high-volume payroll, with at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or leadership role.
* Strong working knowledge of Australian payroll legislation – Fair Work, Modern Awards, NES, PAYG, STP, Superannuation, Payroll Tax – and New Zealand legislation and the relevant Enterprise Agreements.
* Demonstrated experience managing payroll compliance in a complex, multi-state Australian environment, with a proven ability to interpret legislation and implement the resulting process changes.
* Experience with HRIS and payroll systems (SuccessFactors, UKG Pro, and SAP as an advantage), and knowledge of Excel macros and Google Sheets for calculations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Control & Protection System Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Oversee day-to-day departmental operations, ensuring consistent design practices, adherence to global processes, and delivery of technical solutions that meet project and tender objectives.
* Be the owner of all aspects of Control & Protection system deployment, system Configuration, and validation, as well as all usual integration challenges of the control & protection system
* Understanding of advanced modelling and simulation of HVDC Control & Protection systems, including:
* Electromagnetic transient studies (PSCAD, EMTP-RV)
* Control and protection system modelling (MATLAB/Simulink)
* Network conversion, modelling, tuning, and verification (PSSE, PSCAD, RSCAD)
* Full plant/system modelling with end-to-end validation across multiple platforms
* Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering talent to build a high-performing, resilient organisation.
* Identify and implement improvements in engineering tools, processes, systems, and technical solutions to enhance customer value and operational efficiency.
* Provide guidance and leadership to specialists, supervisors, and staff while fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment.
* Demonstrate technical excellence, professionalism, and a strong commitment to safety in all activities.
* Execute and provide guidance for the analysis / evaluation of assigned projects that meet business standards, practices and procedures and the product / program requirements. Build strategic partnerships to advance departmental and organisational goals.
* Make informed decisions regarding work processes, operational plans, schedules, and priorities to achieve departmental objectives.
* Manage engineering resources, workloads, schedules, and project milestones.
* Define project work breakdown structures (WBS), required resources, and skill sets to ensure timely delivery.
* Uphold and promote Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC Control &Protection System Engineering.
* 12+ years of experience in power system and control System Engineering, and Engineering Team Management

* Proven skills in managing and leading team with strong technical background.

description:

t
