title: FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
description:
**Company: BetterDrones (Knifedge Lab Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)**

**Location: Noida, Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh**

**Experience: 1–3 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Travel Requirement: Extensive travel across India, including remote and difficult terrain**

**About BetterDrones**

BetterDrones is a drone intelligence and geospatial technology company specializing in drone inspections, GIS, LiDAR, mapping, surveying, and AI-powered infrastructure inspection solutions.

We work with power utilities, renewable energy companies, EPC contractors, railways, and government organizations to inspect, map, and manage critical infrastructure using advanced drone and geospatial technologies.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Field Operations Executive with a Civil Engineering or Surveying background to manage and execute field survey and infrastructure inspection projects across India.**

The role involves managing Surveyor and DGPS (Differential Global Positioning System) teams, coordinating field activities, monitoring survey quality, handling client communication, and ensuring timely project execution.

This is a demanding, field-intensive position — not a desk-based operations or coordination job. Project locations may include difficult terrain, uneven ground, remote areas, long walking routes, and sites with limited accessibility. Candidates must be prepared to work in challenging field conditions and stay at project locations for extended periods.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked as Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, or Civil Site Engineers and are ready to take ownership of teams, clients, and end-to-end field execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Field Survey & Project Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute field surveying, DGPS, mapping, and infrastructure inspection projects.
* Understand project requirements, survey methodology, site conditions, manpower needs, and equipment requirements before deployment.
* Monitor field progress and ensure survey activities are completed as per project specifications and timelines.
* Visit project sites and actively supervise field execution whenever required.
* Ensure teams are prepared to work in challenging terrain, remote locations, and physically demanding field conditions.

**Surveyor & DGPS Team Management**

* Lead and manage Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, field engineers, and other deployed personnel.
* Allocate work, plan daily routes, monitor productivity, and ensure adequate field coverage.
* Verify that teams understand survey instructions, coordinates, benchmarks, data collection requirements, and project deliverables.
* Resolve field-level challenges related to manpower, equipment, access, productivity, and survey execution.
* Maintain team discipline, accountability, attendance, and adherence to company policies.

**Client Coordination & Site Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during field execution.
* Coordinate site access, survey requirements, permissions, daily progress, and project schedules.
* Communicate technical and operational issues clearly and professionally.
* Handle client queries, field-level escalations, and execution-related concerns.
* Provide regular progress updates and ensure client expectations are aligned with actual site conditions and project timelines.

**Survey Quality & Technical Coordination**

* Review survey records, field measurements, DGPS observations, coordinates, and daily field reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, survey procedures, and required accuracy standards.
* Coordinate with GIS, data processing, and project teams for data transfer, validation, and final deliverables.
* Identify gaps, errors, and incomplete field data and arrange corrective action.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure data completeness before project closure.

**Planning, Logistics & Equipment Management**

* Plan manpower deployment, travel, accommodation, local transportation, and field logistics.
* Coordinate the movement and availability of DGPS equipment, GNSS receivers, survey instruments, drones, batteries, and accessories as applicable.
* Ensure equipment is maintained, handled, and used correctly.
* Anticipate operational risks and arrange resources to minimize downtime and project delays.

**Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily progress reports, project trackers, manpower reports, and field status updates.
* Monitor project timelines, team productivity, survey coverage, data quality, and pending activities.
* Escalate resource shortages, technical issues, and schedule risks promptly.
* Coordinate with management and internal departments to ensure timely project completion.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

**Essential Requirements**

* 3–6 years of experience in civil surveying, DGPS/GNSS surveying, land surveying, infrastructure projects, or field operations.
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a related technical discipline.
* Practical understanding of field survey execution, survey instruments, site measurements, and survey documentation.
* Experience managing or coordinating field teams, preferably Surveyor and DGPS teams.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage client interactions professionally.
* Ability to plan field activities, resolve on-site problems, and manage project deadlines.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting, and project documentation.
* Willingness and physical readiness to work in demanding field conditions and travel extensively across India.

**Preferred Experience**

* Power transmission line and distribution network surveys.
* Transmission line route surveys and corridor mapping.
* DGPS, GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or similar surveying workflows.
* Railway, highway, solar, industrial, and other infrastructure surveys.
* LiDAR surveys, drone mapping, and geospatial data collection.
* Experience coordinating with government departments, power utilities, EPC contractors, and infrastructure clients.
* Hands-on experience as a Surveyor or Survey Engineer with subsequent team-management responsibilities.

**Field Conditions — Please Read Before Applying**

**Candidates must understand the practical demands of this role:**

* Projects may be located in remote, hilly, uneven, forested, rural, or otherwise difficult-to-access areas, depending on the assignment.
* Fieldwork may involve extensive walking, long outdoor working hours, changing weather, and physically demanding site conditions.
* Some projects require extended stays away from Noida, with travel schedules determined by operational requirements.
* The role requires active supervision of Surveyor and DGPS teams, not merely assigning tasks from the office.
* Candidates must be comfortable handling field personnel, resolving site-level issues, and communicating with clients under pressure.
* Work conditions vary by project, and candidates should be prepared for both relatively accessible sites and challenging terrain.
* Please apply only if you are genuinely comfortable with the field requirements and nationwide travel.

**Why Join BetterDrones?**

* Work on large-scale power and infrastructure surveying and inspection projects.
* Gain exposure to DGPS, GIS, LiDAR, drone mapping, and advanced geospatial technologies.
* Work with experienced professionals and enterprise infrastructure clients.
* Develop leadership experience in field operations and project execution.
* Build a career in the growing drone and geospatial technology industry.

**Who Should Apply?**

Civil Engineers, Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, and field professionals who combine practical surveying knowledge, team-management ability, strong client communication, and a willingness to work in challenging field conditions.

Candidates with only office-based coordination experience and no relevant field or surveying exposure may not be suitable for this position.

title: Vertical Head
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Vertical Head – Sales

Location: Noida | Full-Time, On-site

Salary: up to ₹10 LPA (Fixed) + Performance-Based Incentives

About Sutra Luminis

Sutra Luminis is a premium decorative lighting brand catering to high-end residential, hospitality, and commercial projects across India. We work closely with architects, interior designers, hotel groups, developers, contractors, and other key stakeholders to deliver bespoke lighting solutions.

As we scale our sales and project business across India, we are seeking a dynamic and result-driven Vertical Head – Sales to lead, build, and expand a high-value sales vertical.

Role Objective

To lead and scale the sales vertical by developing strategic business relationships, acquiring key accounts, driving project-based sales, and achieving revenue targets. The role will be responsible for revenue ownership, sales strategy, business development, key account management, team leadership (if applicable), and long-term business expansion across India.

Key Responsibilities

1. Revenue Leadership & Target Ownership

* Own and drive monthly revenue targets of scalable based on business and pipeline maturity.
* Develop and execute quarterly and annual sales strategies.
* Drive project and solution-based sales across hospitality, commercial, institutional, and luxury residential segments.
* Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and profitability targets.

2. Sales Strategy & Business Expansion

* Develop and implement the go-to-market strategy for the assigned vertical.
* Identify new markets, customer segments, and high-potential business opportunities.
* Build long-term strategic relationships to generate repeat and referral business.
* Expand the company's presence across key cities and markets.

3. Client Acquisition & Relationship Management

* Acquire and develop high-value customers and strategic accounts.
* Build strong relationships with CXO-level and senior decision-makers.
* Drive customer engagement from initial discussion through order closure and repeat business.
* Ensure strong customer retention and account growth.

4. Project & Sales Pipeline Management

* Maintain and monitor a live pipeline of 30–40 active opportunities/projects.
* Track opportunities from lead generation and requirement understanding through negotiation, closure, billing, and payment realization.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline visibility.

5. Team & Internal Coordination (If Applicable)

* Guide, mentor, and monitor sales team members within the vertical.
* Set clear targets and review individual and team performance.
* Coordinate with design, production, supply chain, and finance teams for smooth execution.
* Ensure seamless handover from sales closure to project execution.

6. Client Engagement & Business Development

* Conduct structured meetings, presentations, and site visits.
* Present suitable lighting solutions based on client requirements, drawings, budgets, and project specifications.
* Lead commercial negotiations and high-value deal closures.
* Develop new business opportunities through networking, referrals, market visits, and strategic relationships.

7. Market Intelligence & Growth Planning

* Identify upcoming projects and business opportunities across target markets.
* Track market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities for new products, customized solutions, and additional revenue streams.
* Provide recommendations to leadership for business expansion.

8. Reporting & Governance

* Maintain strict CRM discipline and accurate sales data.
* Share structured weekly and monthly sales performance reports with leadership.
* Ensure accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline planning.
* Monitor targets, conversion, collections, and overall vertical performance.

Who You Are

* Graduate/Postgraduate with 5–8 years of experience in B2B/project sales.
* Experience in lighting, electricals, building materials, furniture, interior solutions, architectural products, or related industries preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving strong monthly revenue in project-based sales.
* Strong business development, negotiation, and commercial skills.
* Experience handling high-value accounts and large projects.
* Strong relationship-building and client management skills.
* Comfortable with travel across Delhi NCR and major metro cities.
* Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and execution skills.

Why Join Us?

* Lead and scale a high-impact sales vertical.
* Work with leading architects, designers, developers, contractors, and businesses.
* Transparent incentive structure linked directly to performance.
* Opportunity to influence major residential, commercial, hospitality, and institutional projects across India.
* Fast-growth environment with direct leadership visibility.

**Job Description**
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 43,000 employees.
  
  
**About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited**
***JubilantIngreviaisnowamemberoftheeliteGlobalLighthouseNetwork(GLN) oftheWorldEconomicForum(WEF)***
***Celebrating our Culture and People.***
***We are proud to be aGreat Place to Work certified!***
Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.
  
  
Ingrevia is born out of a union of ‘Ingredients’ and ‘Life’ (‘Vie’ in French). Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is committed to offering high-quality and innovative life science ingredients to enrich all forms of life.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia, a global integrated Life Science products and Innovative Solutions provider serving, Pharmaceutical, Nutrition, Agrochemical, Consumer and Industrial customers with our customised products and solutions that are innovative, cost-effective and conforming to excellent quality standards.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited offers a broad portfolio of high-quality ingredients that find application in a wide range of industries. Jubilant Ingrevia’s portfolio also extends to custom development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and agrochemical customers on an exclusive basis.
  
  
Ourbusinessissplitacross3businessverticals,withgloballeadership acrossourkeyproductlines.
  
  
***Speciality Chemicals:***
The Specialty Chemical business of Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures Pyridine, Picolines and its forward integration derivatives, which finds application in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes, solvents, metal finishes, fine chemicals, semiconductors etc.
  
  
We have also launched new platform of Diketene & its value-added derivatives for multiple industry use. We are an established ‘partner of choice’ in CDMO, with more investment plans in GMP & Non-GMP multi-product facilities for Pharma, Agro and Semi-conductor customers.
  
  
***Chemical Intermediates:***
The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.
  
  
***Nutrition & Health Solutions:***
The Nutrition & Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 & Picolinates (Chromium & Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high-quality feed & food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua & pet food industry. In Human Nutrition & Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients & premix solutions to nutrition.
  
  
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in India. We practice world-class manufacturing processes in our day-to-day operations, assuring our customers with unmatched quality and timely delivery of products through innovations and cutting-edge technology. Transforming Manufacturing for Operational Excellence & Sustainability with “zero tolerance to any non-compliance” is the core focus of Jubilant Ingrevia Manufacturing.
  
  
We have 5 world-class manufacturing facilities i.e. One in UP at Gajraula, Two in Gujarat at Bharuch and Savli, Two in Maharashtra at Nira and Ambernath.
  
  
***Environment Sustainability***
The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.
  
  
Find out more about us at www.jubilantingrevia.com
  
  
**The Position**
**Organization : -**
Jubilant Ingrevia Limited
  
  
**Designation & Level: -**
Deputy Manager- Technology & Design
  
  
**Location: -**
Greater Noida
  
  
**Reporting Manager: -**
Senior Manager, Technology & Design
  
  
**Summary**
The role is responsible for end-to-end process engineering support, from technology transfer to commissioning of new molecules. Key activities include evaluating industrial-scale feasibility, conducting pilot trials, developing conceptual designs, and ensuring safe, efficient scale-up of processes. The position leads hazard identification, participates in PHA studies, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to implement engineering modifications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technology Transfer & Feasibility
* Receive and absorb new process technology from R&D.
* Assess feasibility of the process for industrial-scale implementation.
* Process Understanding & Optimization
* Observe lab demonstrations to understand the process and collect data for pilot trials and conceptual design.
* Suggest deviation parameters for industrial-scale systems and validate performance in the lab.
* Define process performance norms at lab scale.
* Generate material and energy balance.
* Pilot Trials & Scale-Up
* Map process steps in the pilot system with the pilot plant operations team.
* Monitor pilot plant trials, observe process behaviour, and generate process parameters.
* Lead troubleshooting during pilot trials with operations and R&D teams.
* Demonstrate process performance at pilot scale and define benchmarks.
* Conduct engineering lab studies to generate scale-up data.
* Conceptual Design & Engineering
* Develop conceptual design for plant-scale operations.
* Share designs with Operations, Engineering, HSE, Projects, and SCM teams; incorporate feedback.
* Prepare engineering modification proposals to ensure process performance.
* Provide process engineering support from concept to commissioning of new molecules.
* Safety & Risk Management
* Identify process hazards and define safeguards for catastrophic risks.
* Lead hazard identification and safeguard definition during conceptual design.
* Participate in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) studies as a process expert.
* Commissioning & Handover
* Participate in process commissioning activities with cross-functional teams to establish performance.
* Troubleshoot issues during commissioning and define action plans for performance gaps.
* Prepare commissioning reports and formally hand over the process to Operations

**The Person**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* BE/B. Tech. in Chemical Engineering with 5-10 years of experience in Process Engineering of specialty chemicals, agrochemicals fields.
* Knowledge on Tech. transfer, process safety aspects & implementation of it in conceptual design stage itself.
* Good knowledge on Process Equipment design & its troubleshooting

**Personal Attributes**

* Excellent interpersonal and people management skills.
* Strategic thinker with a solution-oriented mindset and strong execution capabilities.
* Effective in matrix organizations; adept at cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership in building and retaining high-performing teams

With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day in the life:**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.
  
  

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.
  
  

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.
  
  

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

#FCMIN
  
  
**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
  
  
**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

title: Operations Lead - E-commerce & Quick Commerce
description:
**Run the engine behind two fast-growing consumer brands.**

**Wonder Goods is a profitable D2C company behind WonderStand**
(home and kitchen organizers) and
**Mr. Right**
(pest control, automotive and home care). Our products move every day across
**Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart**
, backed by our own manufacturing and warehouse.

We're a founder-led team at the point where operations decide how fast we grow. We're looking for an Operations Lead who has done this before and wants to own it, not just run it.

**What you'll own**

* End-to-end operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart
* POs, dispatch and fulfilment discipline, so every order and every PO goes out on time
* Platform account health: complaint scores, seller metrics, disputes, settlements and RTVs
* Warehouse and stock: inward/outward, inventory accuracy, warehouse-HO coordination
* Leading a team of Ops Executives and working with our warehouse team
* Building the processes, trackers and SOPs that let ops scale without firefighting
* Working directly with the founders, with real say in how operations are run

**Who you are (mandatory)**

* **5+ years in operations in the E-commerce / Quick Commerce industry**
  , OR
* **5+ years in operations at a D2C brand, working directly with E-commerce and Quick Commerce platforms**

*Profiles without E-commerce, Quick Commerce or D2C platform experience will not be considered.*

**You'll stand out if you have**

* Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller/Vendor Central, Flipkart, and Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart backends
* A track record of fixing dispatch delays, PO acceptance issues or account health problems
* Experience leading a small ops team and coordinating with warehouse staff
* Comfort reporting directly to founders and making decisions without waiting for a process to exist

**Why Wonder Goods**

* **Ownership:**
  you run operations end-to-end, not one slice of them
* **Direct founder access:**
  decisions happen in conversations, not approval chains
* **Visible impact:**
  your work shows up directly in sales, stock availability and customer experience
* **Profitable and growing:**
  stability of a profitable business, pace of a startup

**Details**

* **Location:**
  Sector 63, Noida (on-site), with warehouse coordination
* **Compensation:**
  competitive, based on experience

title: Sr. Property Manager
description:
You will be in charge of the entire bouquet of Property Management Services provided at the site. Your role will be to ensure smooth operations at the facility/site by enhancing efficiency using innovation and technology. Your role will encompass and not be limited to:
  
  

* Ensuring manpower at the site is enabled to face challenges by guiding, grooming, developing and supporting them as and when required.
* Formulating suitable budgeting controls and Monitoring SLA’s & KPI’s for JLL and outsourced agencies towards effective service deliverance.
* Maintaining service level agreements and keeping performance indicator scores above excellence.
* Ensuring timely renewal of the agreement, submission of invoices and follow-ups for the payments.
* Overseeing all vendor quotations and invoices.
* Ensure proper signoffs for attendance and all the required details for cost sheet submission.
* Ensuring timely submission of client approved cost sheet to JLL office and following up for the invoice.
* Ensuring Accuracy of billing information.
* Manpower planning for the site (playing a major role in their hiring process etc.)
* Conducting daily site rounds to ensure proper maintenance of all structures/ building facilities and services are carried out.
* Ensure proper teamwork for all the facilities.
* Assisting client SPOC in creating the annual budget for site operations and formulating strategies for effective management.
* Reviewing and ensuring data (hard and soft copy)/ e-mails/ client files are updated.
* Dealing with occupants’ queries in verbal/ written form.
* Ensuring robust complaint management process is in place and is followed meticulously
* Communicating and circulating information to occupants’ authorities on operational complications.
* Ensuring health and life safety regulations/ manuals are adhered on site
* All risk assessment recommendations are implemented and enforced for compliances.
* Creating business continuity plans.
* Resolving emergency maintenance matters with urgency.
* Maintaining exemplary relationship management with projects, consultants, contractors, govt. authorities, statutory agencies for ease and smooth operations and maintenance of the property.
* Creating and submitting the daily management report (DMR) and the monthly management reports (MMR).
* Coordinate and maintain the as-built drawing and transition document library.
* Work closely with the regional RO / HO / SME/ Training teams and ensure closures of all required reports.
* Facilitate the services under the Slogan “No Safety No Work”.

title: Network Operation Specialist
description:
Manager – Telecom is responsible for enterprise telecom capacity planning, demand forecasting, circuit commissioning, provider governance, telecom optimization, and service delivery across the organization's global network infrastructure. The role ensures adequate network capacity, resilient connectivity, optimized telecom costs, and seamless delivery of telecom services supporting business operations across WAN, Internet, MPLS, and Cloud.

title: Operations Lead – Mapping Production (US Clients)
description:
**Founder's Office – Operations Lead**

**Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders**

**The role**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

**Find the problems that matter**

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

**Support the founders**

* Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
* Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.

**You must have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
* Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
* A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
* Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
* Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
* Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.

**Good to have**

* Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

title: Accounts Payable Manager
description:
**Global Shared Services | Procure-to-Pay (P2P)**

**The Role**

The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for leading the global Accounts Payable (AP) function supporting U.S. and European entities while serving as a key leader within the Global Shared Services organization. This role provides oversight of end-to-end AP operations, including invoice processing, payment execution, month-end close activities, supplier management, compliance, and audit readiness.

The successful candidate will lead and develop a high-performing AP team, including the AP Supervisor and AP Specialists, while driving operational excellence, service quality, and continuous process improvement across the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational support and serves as a trusted business partner to Procurement, Treasury, Corporate Accounting, FP&A, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders. The AP Manager will champion standardization, automation, digital transformation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, enhance the employee and supplier experience, and support the organization's broader finance transformation objectives.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader, coach, and change agent who can balance operational execution with long-term organizational development, continuous improvement, and innovation.

**Essential Functions**

**Global AP Operations & Payments**

· Lead end-to-end Accounts Payable operations for U.S. and European entities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of PO and non-PO invoices, payments, and related activities.

· Oversee AP service delivery, ensuring compliance with established service levels, policies, and internal controls.

· Monitor invoice volumes, aging, exception queues, processing cycle times, and operational KPIs to drive efficiency and performance.

· Review and resolve complex invoice, supplier, tax, banking, and payment issues escalated by the AP team.

· Ensure compliance with company policies, purchasing requirements, accounting standards, internal controls, and global P2P procedures.

· Oversee payment processing activities, including ACH, wire transfers, SEPA, checks, virtual cards, and other regional payment methods, while maintaining appropriate approval workflows and segregation of duties.

· Partner with Treasury to optimize payment strategies, manage risk, and support cash flow objectives.

· Drive operational consistency and standardization across legal entities and regions.

**Vendor Management & Business Partnership**

· Serve as the primary escalation point for strategic supplier relationships and complex vendor disputes.

· Partner closely with Procurement to support purchasing compliance, supplier onboarding, and vendor master governance.

· Collaborate with business leaders, Controllers, FP&A, Treasury, and operational stakeholders to improve end-to-end P2P effectiveness.

· Ensure supplier inquiries are resolved professionally and within established service-level expectations.

· Drive improvements in supplier experience, communication, and self-service capabilities.

· Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders while promoting policy compliance and process discipline.

**Month-End Close & Financial Reporting**

· Lead month-end AP close activities across multiple legal entities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of AP-related accounting activities.

· Review and approve AP accruals, un-invoiced liabilities, cutoff adjustments, and GR/IR account balances.

· Oversee AP account reconciliations, aging reviews, and resolution of outstanding items and exceptions.

· Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllers to support accurate financial reporting and close execution.

· Ensure AP transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with accounting policies and regulatory requirements.

· Support quarter-end and year-end financial reporting activities.

**Compliance, Controls & Audit**

· Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, company policies, and regulatory obligations.

· Oversee vendor master controls, supplier banking validations, tax documentation, and payment security processes.

· Monitor compliance with 1099, VAT, e-Invoicing, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

· Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and compliance risks across AP processes.

· Support internal, external, and SOX audits, including audit testing, documentation, and remediation activities.

· Maintain a strong control environment while driving process efficiency and standardization.

**Process Improvement, Transformation & Innovation**

· Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the AP organization with a focus on simplification, standardization, automation, and scalability.

· Champion a culture of operational excellence, encouraging employees to identify opportunities to improve service, efficiency, controls, and stakeholder experience.

· Drive finance transformation initiatives and support the evolution of Global Shared Services operating models.

· Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions that improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

· Lead implementation and optimization efforts for systems including SAP S/4HANA, Concur, Navan, Levelpath, ServiceNow, BlackLine, and other AP technologies.

· Use data, metrics, and analytics to identify trends, root causes, and process improvement opportunities.

· Partner with Finance, Procurement, IT, and Shared Services leadership to implement high-impact transformation initiatives.

**AI & Digital Enablement**

· Serve as a champion and advocate for AI-enabled Accounts Payable transformation.

· Identify opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence, automation, intelligent document processing, analytics, and workflow technologies to improve operational effectiveness.

· Develop and promote digital-first ways of working across the AP organization.

· Coach and educate team members on emerging technologies and opportunities to enhance productivity through AI and automation.

· Drive adoption of AI-assisted tools for invoice processing, exception management, supplier support, reporting, and workflow management.

· Ensure appropriate governance, controls, compliance, and auditability for AI-enabled processes.

· Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.

**Metrics & Performance Management**

· Establish and monitor AP KPIs, dashboards, and service-level performance metrics.

· Analyze operational results, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and drive data-based decision-making.

· Present performance insights to leadership and implement action plans to improve efficiency, service quality, and customer satisfaction.

**Team Leadership, Coaching & Talent Development**

· Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Accounts Payable team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

· Manage talent initiatives including hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and employee development.

· Build organizational capability through training, knowledge sharing, leadership development, and career growth opportunities

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

**Core Competencies**

· Leadership & Talent Development – Builds, develops, and retains high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and engagement.

· Strategic & Continuous Improvement Mindset – Balances operational execution with transformation, process improvement, and business objectives.

· AI & Innovation Leadership – Drives automation, AI adoption, and digital transformation to deliver measurable business value.

· Operational Excellence – Ensures accuracy, compliance, efficiency, and service quality through strong process discipline.

· Business Partnership & Customer Focus – Builds trusted cross-functional relationships and delivers exceptional stakeholder and supplier experiences.

· Problem Solving & Change Leadership – Resolves complex issues and successfully leads business, process, and technology change.

· Technical & Analytical Expertise – Leverages ERP systems, automation tools, financial controls, and data analytics to drive results.

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 9+ years of progressive Accounts Payable experience.

· 3+ years of leadership experience managing AP teams in a shared services or global environment.

· Strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay processes, AP operations, supplier management, and payment processing.

· Experience supporting U.S. and international AP operations.

· Knowledge of VAT regulations, e-Invoicing, and international AP requirements.

· Strong understanding of SOX, internal controls, audit requirements, segregation of duties, and compliance frameworks.

· Experience with enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur, Navan, Levelpath, ServiceNow, BlackLine, or similar platforms.

· Demonstrated success leading process improvement, transformation, automation, or operational excellence initiatives.

· Proven ability to coach, mentor, and develop employees and leaders.

· Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

· Experience using metrics and data to drive operational performance and decision-making.

· Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and partner effectively with senior leadership

title: Construction Manager
description:
Hi,

Greetings from Peoplefy Infosolutions !!!

We are hiring for one of our reputed client based in
**Noida/ Pune/ Navi Mumbai**
.

We are looking for candidates with 14+ years of experience.

**Education: B.E./ B. Tech (Electrical/Mechanical)**

**Job Description:**

The Construction Manager will take the ownership of leading the project from inception till handover. He / She would lead a team of resources from varied technical backgrounds and also a team of other project stakeholders that would include architects, vendors, and contractors and manage the project throughout the complete lifecycle through seamless delivery of an end to end Project Management scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Charter**

* Understand the project requirements from the client and develop a detailed Project Charter that would include a broad strategy for delivering the Project Management Scope, identification of key stakeholders who would be required from the project inception till closure, define the procurement plan that is merged with the baseline schedule and spell out critical milestones that would be the guiding factor for successful project completion
* Align all the key stakeholders with the Charter and prepare a draft Project Execution Plan
* Collaborate with clients team and prepare a project matrix clearly defining the process for flow of information and internal approval process

**2. Project Planning**

* Provide inputs with regards to sequencing of activities in the master schedule to include design reviews, drawing delivery schedule, procurement, equipment delivery and installation, construction sequencing and testing & commissioning plans
* Guide the project Planning Manager / Engineer in finalizing the Master Schedule in the inception stage (after acceptance of Project Charter) and then finalizing the detailed project schedule in the final design concept stage (before commencement of Procurement activities)

**3. High level budgeting and costing**

* Develop high level budget based on available details and with support from planning, civil and MEP teams during the inception stage and update the costing during different stages of the project ie from concept stage to vendor / supplier finalization.
* Establish unit rates for materials and labor based on current market data and historical benchmarks
* Regularly update cost database to reflect trends and regional price fluctuations

**4. Tendering & Bid Support**

* Lead the tendering process by developing contractor / subcontractor scopes, bid assumptions, relevant tender clauses and risk allowances
* Analyze tender documents, drawings, and specifications to determine labor, material, and equipment requirements
* Suggest clients on tender clarifications, tender event schedule and evaluate technical submissions by vendors / suppliers in line with clients requirements
* Carry out vendor / supplier evaluation (with support from project teams) with respect to technical details and project delivery
* Take ownership of the Tender Event Schedule right up to the award of contract

**5**
.
**Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Plan for Value Engineering workshop during the concept design and then before design finalization stage of the project
* Identify opportunities to reduce cost by suggesting alternate materials, or design modifications.
* Guide the planning and design management teams to update on schedule, delivery status and change management

**6. Coordination & Collaboration**

* Coordinate with team members during all the stages of the project to ensure plans are updated as per project status
* Proactively involve in the Risk Management scope and suggest mitigation measures as and when a risk is identified so as to keep the project timelines and cost intact
* Collaborate with the clients team through regular exchange of information, periodic updates and meetings, keeping them informed about the progress at different stages of the project and raising red flags as and when attention is required that needs early resolution
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure design / drawing delivery is as per agreed schedule and support the team in case their delivery is getting affected due to inputs and approvals from required stakeholders
* Collaborate with construction contractor right from their onboarding stage and through the construction process for a seamless execution as per plan, desired quality standards and within assigned project budget
* Conduct regular reviews with key stakeholders to ensure risks are identified proactively and mitigated, project delivery plans are intact and identification of bottlenecks and early resolution
* Conduct site visits, resolve RFIs, and ensure design intent during construction
* Provide support to the respective teams in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) if these activities are part of our scope

**7. Change Management**

* Prepare a detailed change management process that is defined at the beginning of the project, approved by client and accepted by all stakeholders
* Ensure the updates on change management are included as part of periodic report to the client
* Review the changes that arise during different project stages with regards to the impact on cost, quality and timelines and ensure if the impact can be minimized through any value engineering initiative before it is submitted for approval to the client

**8. Contract Administration**

* Ensure a draft contract is prepared as per project requirement and shared with the clients team for their approval
* Study and prepare a draft response to any queries that arise from contractor / vendor / suppliers with regards to understanding of the contract as well as during their delivery period
* Support the clients team in case of any legal issues or arbitrations raised by contractor / vendor / suppliers during their respective contract periods and help in preparing draft responses in line with related contract clause

**9.**
**Project Handover and Closeout**

* Coordinate with Design, Contractor and Vendor / Supplier teams with regards to their respective project timelines and ensure timely closure of their scope as per agreed timelines
* Support project teams to develop a detailed Handover Document to include financial closure that is reviewed and checked in line with the project cost to completion (as per updates during the project life-cycle)

**10. Continuous Improvement**

* Coordinate with all stakeholders to capture lessons learnt and review operational feedback that can be included as a process / project delivery improvement plan for subsequent projects

**Interested candidates for above position kindly share your CVs on-**

***sneh.ne@peoplefy.com***

Thank you,

Sneh

title: Senior Operations Manager – GIS / Mapping Operations
description:
**Title: Operations Manager**

**No of Positions: 1**

**Company: SiteRecon**

**Industry: Internet/Web Software**

**Employment Type: Full Time**

**Location: Noida (Work from Office) - Six days' week**

**Experience: 8-10 Years**

**Team Size Managed: 50–200**

**Role Overview:**

The Operations Manager at SiteRecon will be responsible for leading and scaling our Property Mapping Operations. This is a high-ownership, hands-on leadership role suited for someone comfortable managing large teams in a fast-paced, metrics-driven production environment.

You will own day-to-day execution of mapping operations, with direct responsibility for throughput, quality, delivery SLAs, productivity, capacity planning, and team performance.

You will directly manage
**6–8 Team Leads and QA Supervisors**
and indirectly manage
**120+ cartographers**
, ensuring smooth execution across shifts and consistent delivery for our US and Canada customers.

This role requires someone who can identify bottlenecks, build scalable processes, improve productivity, strengthen quality systems, and use data to continuously improve operational performance.

**About SiteRecon:**

SiteRecon helps property maintenance contractors in the US automate property mapping and site visits through its mapping platform, helping them save time, speed up sales, and improve profitability. We are building a property intelligence platform for businesses in North America.

**About Team:**

Started by IIT Delhi alumni who have worked with multinationals in satellite imaging, e-commerce, and edtech sectors.

To learn more about the team & our origin story -
https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

To learn more about what we do for our customers -
https://order.siterecon.ai

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day Property Mapping Operations with control over output, quality, productivity, and delivery timelines.
* Manage operations across multiple shifts and teams to ensure predictable execution.
* Directly manage Team Leads and QA Supervisors and set clear priorities and performance expectations.
* Indirectly manage 120+ cartographers through the operations leadership structure.
* Establish operating rhythms, accountability, and review mechanisms across teams.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and take corrective action to maintain business continuity.
* Ensure processes are scalable as customer volume and business requirements grow.

**SLA & Productivity Ownership:**

Own operational delivery SLAs and ensure customer commitments are consistently met.

* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly productivity and throughput across teams.
* Track TAT, output per person/team, pending workload, backlog, and key operational metrics.
* Identify productivity gaps and drive improvements with Team Leads.
* Improve throughput without compromising mapping quality.
* Analyse SLA breaches, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish productivity benchmarks and prioritise work during high-demand periods.

**Quality & Process Improvement**

* Own overall mapping quality and establish effective quality-control mechanisms.
* Implement and continuously improve SOPs for mapping and quality processes.
* Work with QA Supervisors and Team Leads to identify recurring quality issues and rework.
* Reduce rework through root-cause analysis and process improvements.
* Monitor mapping accuracy and quality deviations.
* Establish feedback loops between QA and production teams to improve first-time-right output.
* Standardize and communicate process changes across shifts.

**Planning , Forecasting & Capacity Management:**

* Forecast mapping demand and translate workload into manpower and capacity requirements.
* Maintain adequate capacity to meet current and projected customer demand.
* Prepare manpower plans for seasonal fluctuations and volume spikes.
* Identify capacity constraints before they impact delivery SLAs.
* Optimize allocation of people and workload across teams and shifts.
* Balance utilization, productivity, quality, and turnaround time while planning capacity.

**People Management & Leadership:**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Team Leads and QA Supervisors.
* Set measurable goals and review leadership-team performance using operational metrics.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Identify high performers and develop them for larger leadership responsibilities.
* Address performance gaps through structured improvement plans.
* Handle operational escalations and support Team Leads in resolving people and performance issues.
* Maintain team morale while ensuring performance and delivery standards.
* Build a strong second line of leadership.

**Cross- Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify operational bottlenecks and improve mapping workflows.
* Collaborate with Customer Success on customer requirements, delivery issues, and recurring operational challenges.
* Provide operational inputs for product and process improvements.
* Partner with other functions to implement process or system changes.
* Drive alignment and resolve operational issues at the root level.

**Operational Reporting, MIS & Insight:**

* Own operational dashboards and MIS reporting for the Property Mapping function.
* Establish regular reporting for productivity, quality, SLA adherence, TAT, capacity, backlog, and other KPIs.
* Provide leadership with clear, data-driven visibility into operational performance.
* Conduct regular business reviews with Team Leads and operational leadership.
* Identify trends, deviations, and operational risks through data.
* Recommend corrective actions based on operational insights and track effectiveness.

**Continuous Improvement & Scalability:**

* Build a culture of continuous improvement across Operations.
* Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes and develop better ways of working.
* Standardize successful processes across teams and shifts.
* Use data and structured problem-solving to identify root causes and prevent recurring issues.
* Build processes that support significant growth in mapping volume without proportionately increasing operational complexity.

**Experience & Skills:**

* 8–10 years of experience in operations management, preferably in GIS, mapping, analytics, BPO/KPO, digital operations, or other high-volume production environments.
* Proven experience managing large teams of
  **50–200+ people**
  .
* Experience managing managers/team leads and building a multi-layer operational structure.
* Strong hands-on experience with KPIs, SLAs, productivity, capacity planning, and quality management.
* Experience in a metrics-driven, high-volume operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to improve operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and turnaround time.
* Experience handling operational escalations and performance management.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for operational analysis and reporting.
* Ability to build and interpret operational dashboards and MIS reports.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and root causes.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and converting data into actionable insights.
* Experience in a startup, high-growth technology company, or rapidly scaling operations environment is strongly preferred.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Prior experience in a product-led or SaaS company.
* Experience managing GIS, mapping, digital-factory, analytics, BPO/KPO, or other semi-technical operations.
* Experience managing operations for international customers or across different time zones.
* Experience building or scaling operations from an early stage.

**Perks of working at SiteRecon:**

* Opportunity to lead and scale a large, high-impact operations function.
* Work directly with founders and senior leadership.
* High ownership over a core business operation.
* Be part of a rapidly growing AI-driven technology company.
* Freedom to identify operational problems and implement meaningful improvements.
* Growth opportunity to build and scale teams and processes.

title: Manager Managed Services
description:

Our clients range from mid-market enterprises to large global organizations across various industries, including financial services, healthcare, and technology. Engagements are typically governed by well-defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that cover uptime, incident resolution times, change

management, and proactive monitoring.

We are seeking a highly driven and experienced Managed Services Manager to lead our Managed Services business unit. The candidate will oversee presales engagement, operations management, financial accountability, and team leadership, working closely with delivery managers, sales, and senior leadership. title: Manager - Fire and Security
description:
To manage and ensure the overall security, fire & life safety, emergency preparedness and risk management of the mall. The role will be responsible for protecting customers, tenants, employees, assets and infrastructure while ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, fire safety norms, mall SOPs and client standards.

**Job Descriptions:**

* Manage overall security operations of the mall, including entry/exit gates, parking, loading/unloading, BOH, service and common areas.
* Supervise security agencies, manpower deployment, shift rosters and daily operations.
* Ensure effective access control, frisking, baggage/vehicle checks and material movement.
* Monitor CCTV, access control and security control room operations and ensure system uptime.
* Identify and address security risks, theft, unauthorized access, vandalism and suspicious activities.
* Develop and implement security SOPs, post orders and emergency response procedures.

* Prepare and conduct mock drills for fire, evacuation, bomb threats, medical emergencies, civil disturbances and other emergencies.
* Lead emergency response and coordinate with police, fire department, civil defence and other statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, Fire NOC conditions, licenses, inspections and audits.
* Manage tenant and contractor compliance with security, fire safety and work permit requirements.
* Monitor high-risk activities such as hot work, work-at-height and contractor movement.
* Lead and train Security Officers, Supervisors, Guards, Fire Officers, Firemen and Control Room personnel.
* Conduct regular briefings, toolbox talks, patrols and surprise checks to maintain discipline and operational readiness.
* Investigate security/fire incidents, accidents, thefts and property damage and prepare RCA and corrective action reports.
* Maintain incident records, statutory documents, inspection reports, registers and security/fire MIS.
* Manage VIP visits, mall events, launches and other special security arrangements.
* Implement effective traffic management plans and ensure smooth vehicle and pedestrian movement within the mall.
* Monitor security and fire-related KPIs and drive continuous improvement in safety, security and customer experience.
* Ensure timely reporting and escalation of critical incidents to senior management.

**Requirements:**

* Graduate / Diploma / Degree in Security, Fire & Safety or relevant discipline.
* 8 to 10 Years of relevant experience preferably with Mall / Retail / Hospitality / Commercial / Large Facility Management .
* Strong experience in managing security agencies and large security/fire safety teams.
* Hands-on knowledge of fire & life-safety systems, CCTV, access control and emergency response.
* Good understanding of Fire NOC, statutory compliance, safety audits and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in conducting mock drills, emergency preparedness and incident investigations.
* Strong experience in tenant, contractor and vendor management.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Police, Fire Department, Civil Defence and other authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and crisis-management skills.
* Experience in traffic management and crowd control in high-footfall environments.
* Should be comfortable working in shifts, weekends and during emergencies/events.
* Strong documentation, reporting and MIS skills.
